answer_1.quote: Automatic summarization is a core NLP problem ... We propose adaptations of state-of-the-art extractive and abstractive summarization methods that significantly improve performance when compared to generic summaries.

answer_2.quote: We automatically evaluate the quality of the generated summaries using unigram and bigram overlap (ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2)... We also use BERTScore to compute a similarity score for each token in the generated summaries with each token in the reference summaries.
